18 Canadian courses that deliver big on fun

These courses earned the highest Fun Factor scores in our 2026 Top 100.

By

Staff

Published

October 15, 2026

    • Flipboard

      •

    • Reddit

Instaread

Perhaps the biggest difference between our Top 100 ranking and other such lists is the emphasis we place on fun, which is worth 20 per cent of a course’s overall score. Why? Because we feel there is no better validation of a course’s excellence than it being thoroughly enjoyable to play, again and again.

Fun may encompass all of our categories, too. One might find a course extremely fun because of its beauty, challenge and strategy required to play it well. Maybe it’s the course’s routing or its setting or its conditioning. Its sense of place or its signature par 3s.

More than anything, fun speaks to the feeling you are left with after playing. Would you be excited to tee it up again at the course the next day? Or could you do without another round there for years?

Here are the 18 courses that scored the highest in Fun Factor on our 2026 Top 100 presented by BDO.

Note: Fun Factor scored out of 10.

18. Greywolf Golf Course
Panorama, B.C.
SG Fun Factor Rating: 8.074

17. Blackhawk Golf Club
Nisku, Alta.
SG Fun Factor Rating: 8.106
